_comment: Per-layer coverage baseline. CI gate fails if any layer drops >1pp below these numbers. Targets are the ADR-042 aspirational floors (not enforced — informational).

lib/api/.note: TARGET FLOOR EXCEEDED. Lifted from 77.92% by gap-closure sprint — refactored MOCK_MODE in 17 files to env-driven (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MOCK_API), then added real-fetch.test.ts (59 tests) covering apiFetch URL building + method dispatch for every public function across all clients. 2026-05-07.

lib/auth/.note: Above ADR-042 95% floor (2026-05-03). options.flask.test.ts adds 19 tests covering authorizeWithFlask happy/error paths, refreshAccessToken (Flask + mock branches), jwt() callback first sign-in/reuse/refresh, session() callback (asserts refreshToken NEVER leaks to client), and signOut event. 24.48% → 100% lines.

lib/hooks/.note: TARGET FLOOR EXCEEDED. Lifted from 60.12% by coverage sprint — added tests for use-nav-history, use-keyboard-shortcuts, use-notifications, use-ai-provider-configs, use-ai-skills, use-ai-usage, use-dangerous-action. 2026-05-07.

lib/modules/.note: TARGET FLOOR EXCEEDED. Lifted from 11.11% by gap-closure sprint — added schema validation tests (users, organizations, roles), groupPermissions helper test, useUserActivity hook test, useTakeTicket/useResolveTicket/useReassignTicket/useCommentOnTicket helpdesk hook tests, normalizeJobStatus extension. 2026-05-07.

lib/platform/.note: Bumped 92.20 → 97.78 in batch 155 — incidental coverage from batches 137-153 (ai-actions executor smoke tests, audit-emitter parametric, inferResourceHint export, _validateOne export). Per baseline_update_rule: ≥5pp gain locks new floor. 2026-05-14.

lib/utils/.note: TARGET FLOOR EXCEEDED. Lifted from 28.57% by csv.test.ts + format.test.ts (Track D coverage sprint). 2026-05-07.

lib/utils.ts.note: Smoke test added in R-OPS-01 T01 — this file is the only fully-covered surface

components/shared/.note: Bumped 70.45 → 79.89 in batch 155 — incidental coverage from batches 100s i18n arc + new DataTable render tests (data-table.test.tsx covers main primitive: render/empty/loading/error/selection/onRowClick). Per baseline_update_rule: ≥5pp gain locks new floor. 2026-05-14.

components/shell/.note: Bumped 57.87 → 85.0 (current 89.24) in batch 129 — i18n cleanup arc (batches 95+ ai-assistant + sidebar + brand) added incidental coverage as tests grew to cover useTranslations + locale wrappers. Per baseline_update_rule: ≥5pp gain locks new floor.

app/api/proxy/.note: TARGET FLOOR EXCEEDED. Lifted from 0% by gap-closure sprint — added route.test.ts (13 tests) covering: 401 auth gate (no token / no accessToken), 404 prefix allowlist (unknown + empty), all 5 verbs (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) with body forwarding, query-string preservation, audit headers (X-Client-User-Id/Org-Id), upstream status pass-through, non-JSON body fallback, 502 error masking (no URL leak). vitest config now includes app/api/**/*.test.ts. 2026-05-07.

policy.comparison: current >= baseline - 1pp per layer; CI fails if any layer regresses
policy.baseline_update_rule: Baseline is updated when a story raises a layer's coverage by ≥5pp, OR when a deliberate ADR raises a floor
